visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short dark hair and glasses wearing a white button-down shirt is sitting in a studio environment. Behind him are bookshelves with blurred books and a wooden cabinet under warm yellow lighting. (2) A split-screen graphic appears: the top shows a 2D animation of a street from a driver's perspective, the bottom shows the man gesturing with his hands. (3) The scene transitions to a full-screen 2D map animation of a four-way intersection with green 'sight triangles' highlighted over the corners. (4) A 3D-style urban planning diagram shows buildings with columns (arcades) and red blocks representing visual obstructions. (5) Grainy, desaturated footage of a car collision on a street is shown, followed by vintage black-and-white and sepia-toned archival photographs of historic streetscapes in Taiwan. (6) Modern street footage shows a person in black slipping and falling on a wet pavement surface during a rainy day. (7) Green-painted pedestrian sidewalks with white 'Pedestrian Only' markings are shown on narrow urban streets. (8) The man returns to the screen, pointing downwards with both index fingers while speaking directly to the camera.
